integrity: The lower bound comes from four vertices whose pairwise color inequalities are forced jointly by properness and two size-two neighborhood conflict-free conditions. At equality those four vertices name all available colors. Nested neighborhoods then restrict the first n-1 A-colors and last n-1 B-colors to binary sequences; the singleton condition on every prefix or suffix forces each interior block to be constant. The final endpoint choices are exactly the ones preserving a singleton. The checker independently enumerates small cases and tests every constructed form through n=50.
scientific_limitations: The complete optimizer classification is stated for half graphs H_n with n at least four; H_3 has additional optimal patterns.
The theorem does not cover arbitrary chain graphs with repeated neighborhood twin classes.
Finite exhaustive verification covers n=3,4,5 and is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed treatment of proper conflict-free coloring on half graphs may exist.
title: All optimal proper conflict-free colorings of half graphs
